en: A color postcard view of a small town nestled in a long, green alpine valley, surrounded by steep mountains. The foreground shows terraced fields, orchards, and scattered farmhouses. At the edge of the town there is a prominent church with a tall bell tower and a large nave, and another smaller church with a bell tower appears in the lower left. The valley stretches into the distance between mountain ridges under a lightly clouded sky.
